claims.claim: 02476.HK listed on 2026-04-21 at HKD209.88 and has 110,227,500 H shares after over-allotment.
The A and H lines are separate share classes and must be valued at their own prices; 300476.SZ is not a peer.
At 2026-08-10 close, A traded about 30.4% above the FX-adjusted H price.
FY2025 revenue was RMB19.292bn, net profit RMB4.312bn and gross margin 35.2%.
2026Q1 revenue rose 27.99%, net profit 39.95% and operating cash flow 399.38% year on year.
Top-one and top-five customer shares rose to 29.7% and 51.0% in 2025.
Company aggregate order language is positive, but no named Rubin customer, order value, price or shipment volume is publicly confirmed in the cited documents.
Thailand A1 phase 2 is between qualification and early validation/part-number approval, while A2 is still in construction-to-ramp stages.
The creator said the elevator company obtained Rubin orders and referred to a Jensen Huang oral promise.
The Jensen Huang oral promise and specific Rubin purchase order remain unverified.
The negative rumor that initial Rubin boards failed acceptance and shifted to another supplier remains unverified; the company denied broad negative product/share/project rumors.
Cornerstone shares are subject to a six-month lock-up ending after 2026-10-20, creating a potential—not certain—float event.
Southbound accounts held 25,206,063 H shares, 22.85% of issued H shares, on 2026-08-08.
FY2025 operating cash flow was RMB4.603bn while cash paid for fixed intangible and other long-term assets was RMB6.617bn.
TTM net profit through 2026Q1 was approximately RMB4.680bn using FY2025 plus 2026Q1 minus 2025Q1.
The 2026-08-07 announcement repeated positive aggregate backlog language but stated that no undisclosed material information existed and no interim earnings preview was required.
NVIDIA scheduled FY2027 Q2 results for 2026-08-26 two days before Victory Giant's scheduled interim report.
At 2026-08-10 closing prices mechanical TTM P/E was approximately 60.0x for A shares and 46.0x for H shares after FX conversion.
